ownership.quote: Built by the Lapce Team We are the maintainers behind Lapce and Floem, open source projects trusted by thousands of developers.

stage.quote: A few months ago I started my journey to bootstrap Lapdev[1], an open core solution to manage remote development environments that you self host. It didn't really work out.
stage.note: Founder's own Show HN post (Oct 2024) describes Lapdev as self-funded/bootstrapped; no funding round, investor, or accelerator has been found anywhere. Company later pivoted product from self-hosted Codespaces alternative to a Kubernetes environment platform (per the lapdev-has-changed blog post) and is still in a free public beta with no published pricing.

employees.source: https://lap.dev/about/ describes a small team ('the Lapce Team') but gives no headcount

note: Lapdev is a side project turned small bootstrapped effort by the maintainers of the open-source Lapce code editor and Floem GUI toolkit (GitHub org 'lapce'). Launched March 2024 as a self-hosted Codespaces/Gitpod alternative (Show HN, 230 points); the founder's own Oct 2024 post says the original bootstrapped idea 'didn't really work out.' As of a Nov 2025 blog post ('Lapdev has changed. Here's why.') the product was rebuilt into a Kubernetes environment/App-Catalog platform, still in free public beta with GA pricing unpublished. No evidence of any accelerator, priced funding round, institutional investor, or revenue disclosure exists; treat all financial figures as unknown rather than absent-by-omission.
